hypotheses.rationale: This is the decisive error because the agent failed to perform the critical visual analysis of the painting required to determine the clockwise arrangement and total count of fruits. This incomplete data set caused the Verification_Expert to conclude 'None' were served based on a false premise that the search space was limited to just watermelon, pears, and lemons.
